name: current_time
description: Get the current date and time, optionally in a specific IANA timezone.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, e.g. Asia/Seoul or UTC. Defaults to UTC.

name: calculate
description: Perform an arithmetic operation on two numbers.

operation.description: One of: add, subtract, multiply, divide.

name: fetch_url
description: Fetch a web page and return its visible text, with HTML markup stripped. Long pages are truncated.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to read.

name: create_artifact
description: Create a standalone artifact shown in a panel next to the chat. Call this — do not write the content in your reply — whenever you produce a substantial self-contained document: a full source file, code longer than ~15 lines, a report or spec, a diagram, an HTML page, a dataset. If the user asked for an 'artifact', calling this tool is mandatory.

artifact_id.description: A short kebab-case id you invent for this artifact, e.g. 'q3-revenue-report' or 'fib-py'. Reuse it with update_artifact.

title.description: Short human-readable title, e.g. 'Q3 Revenue Report'.

kind.description: One of markdown, code, html, svg, mermaid, csv, json, text. Use 'mermaid' for any diagram — the panel renders it as a picture.

content.description: The full artifact body. Do not truncate or summarize it.

language.description: For kind='code', the programming language, e.g. 'python'.

name: update_artifact
description: Save a new version of an existing artifact. Use this when the user asks for changes to an artifact you already created, so the panel keeps a version history instead of showing a duplicate.

artifact_id.description: The id you passed to create_artifact.

title.description: Title for this version (may be unchanged).

kind.description: One of markdown, code, html, svg, mermaid, csv, json, text. Use 'mermaid' for any diagram — the panel renders it as a picture.

content.description: The complete revised body. Always send the whole document, never a diff or a fragment.

language.description: For kind='code', the programming language, e.g. 'python'.

name: approve_expense
description: Workshop demo (mock data): record an expense approval for the finance team. Returns an approval id. Amount is whole dollars.

amount.description: Expense amount in whole US dollars.

name: lookup_salary
description: Workshop demo (mock data): look up an employee's salary band for the HR team. Returns a band label, never a figure.
